summary: Full-stack developer with strong expertise in Python/Django and modern JavaScript frameworks. Experienced in building AI-powered applications (LLM integration, speech-to-text, NLP), real-time systems (WebSockets), 3D web graphics (Three.js), e-commerce platforms, and RESTful APIs. Passionate about clean architecture, OOP design, and production-ready deployments.

projects.name: WhatsApp Clone — Real-Time Chat
projects.description: Full-stack real-time messaging application with 1-on-1 chat, typing indicators, read receipts, reactions, voice messages, and Cloudinary media storage. WebSocket-powered via Django Channels with Redis channel layers.

projects.name: Aura Book — E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Full e-commerce SPA for stationery and notebooks. Features product management, shopping cart, order checkout, dual-role system (admin/seller), multiple payment methods (COD, Vodafone Cash, Instapay, Fawry, Credit Card), and social auth.

projects.name: AI Multi-Agent System
projects.description: Multi-agent AI platform with 5 specialized agents: ChatBot (conversation + keyboard detection), CodeBot (programming & execution), DataBot (CSV/JSON analysis), ResearchBot (web search & summarization), and PlannerBot (cross-agent task planning). Integrates with Ollama local LLM.

projects.name: AI Meeting Summarizer
projects.description: Audio/video meeting summarization tool. Upload media files via drag-and-drop, backend processes speech-to-text with faster-whisper, then generates extractive summaries using NLTK, sumy, and scikit-learn.

projects.name: SketchUp Web — 3D Kitchen Designer
projects.description: Browser-based 3D kitchen design tool. Users draw 2D shapes, extrude to 3D, add kitchen components (cabinets, countertops, appliances). Powered by Three.js with orbit controls, raycasting, and push/pull geometry engine.

projects.name: ERD Diagram Tool (build_ARD)
projects.description: Browser-based ERD drawing tool (like draw.io for database schemas). Create tables, set PK/FK constraints, draw relationships with bezier curves, zoom/pan canvas, generate SQL CREATE statements, save/load JSON diagrams.

projects.name: Internship Projects (Flask & Django APIs)
projects.description: Four internship tasks demonstrating API development progression: URL Shortener (Flask, OOP services), Event Registration API (capacity tracking, waitlisting), Restaurant Management API (menu, reservations, inventory, low-stock alerts), and Job Board API (full application workflow).

projects.name: Sedap Talkha — Business Website
projects.description: Static business website for a micro-finance association in Port Said, Egypt. Features hero section, services grid, WhatsApp integration, and mobile-responsive RTL design.

projects.name: CV Android App
projects.description: Native Android app that wraps the CV in a WebView with a full native settings panel. Features include theme switching, font size control, section reordering (drag & drop), add/remove sections, view mode selection, and CI/CD with GitHub Actions for automatic APK builds.
